blocks.h2: Signs Your Mokena Water Heater Needs Repair
blocks.intro: Most repair calls start with one of these:

tiles.body: A pilot, igniter, gas valve or element that stopped working.
A failing burner or element, a broken dip tube or sediment taking up space in the tank.
A drain valve or relief valve leak can be fixed. A leaking tank can't.
Sediment on the bottom of the tank.

blocks.h2: Water Heater Problems in Mokena Homes
blocks.intro: Many Mokena homes are on their second or third water heater by now, and some still have the first one.

items.body: A tank installed when the house was built in the late 1990s or 2000s is well past the usual 8 to 12 years.
Many newer homes have power-vent heaters that vent through the wall. When the fan or pressure switch fails, the heater won't fire.
When the utility room is boxed in, a leak can soak carpet and drywall before anyone sees it.
Some homes in and around Mokena are on private wells. Well water can carry more sediment and minerals into the tank.

bodies: We service every kind of residential water heater in Mokena: gas and electric tanks, power-vent and high-efficiency models and tankless units. We diagnose first and recommend second.

When you call, read us the label on the tank. The fuel type, the size and the manufacture date tell us a lot before we arrive. If it's time to replace it, see [water heater installation](/mokena/water-heater-installation).

A yearly flush clears the sediment at the bottom of the tank, keeps the heater efficient and helps it last. On the same visit we test the relief valve, check the anode rod and look over the burner or elements and the venting.
Tankless heaters get descaled on a schedule. If your heater has never had any maintenance, start here.

steps.body: We test the parts before we talk about cost.

blocks.h2: Water Heater Questions From Mokena Homeowners

items.q: Is my water heater worth repairing?
items.preview: Under about 8 years, usually. Over 12, usually not.
items.answer: If it's under about 8 years old and a part failed, a repair usually makes sense. Past 12 years, or if the tank itself leaks, replacing it is the better value.

items.q: Why does my power-vent water heater keep shutting off?
items.preview: Often the fan, the pressure switch or a blocked vent.
items.answer: Usually a failing vent fan, a bad pressure switch or a vent pipe blocked by snow, ice or a nest. We test each one.

items.q: How long do water heaters last in Mokena?
items.answer: Tank heaters usually last somewhere around 8 to 12 years. Yearly flushing helps them reach the longer end.

items.q: Do you offer water heater maintenance?
items.answer: Yes. We flush the tank, test the relief valve and check the anode rod and venting. Tankless units get descaled.

items.q: How much does water heater repair cost in Mokena?
items.preview: It depends on the part and the heater. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what failed and the type of heater. We diagnose it and you approve a flat-rate price before we start.
